description: This file contains an interface definition for GatewayAuthenticationDirectiveFactory, which specifies methods for creating authentication directives for HTTP and WebSocket APIs within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationDirectiveFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating authentication directives for different API protocols.

methods.name: buildHttpAuthentication
methods.description: Creates an authentication directive for HTTP API requests.

methods.name: buildWsAuthentication
methods.description: Creates an authentication directive for WebSocket API requests.
